source.stem:
Metal X lies between zinc and iron in the reactivity series.

Which statements about metal X are correct?

1  It reacts with steam to produce hydrogen gas.
2  It does not react with steam but will produce hydrogen with dilute acid.
3  The metal can be obtained from its oxide by heating strongly with charcoal.
4  The metal oxide cannot be reduced using carbon.

statements.text: It reacts with steam to produce hydrogen gas.
It does not react with steam but will produce hydrogen with dilute acid.
The metal can be obtained from its oxide by heating strongly with charcoal.
The metal oxide cannot be reduced using carbon.

mx.teacher_note: Crushing chalk is a chemical change.

intelligence.enrichment: A physical change changes physical properties while no new substance is formed; a chemical change forms one or more new substances. Observed evidence of the material staying the same leads to a physical-change classification; evidence that a different substance has formed leads to a chemical-change classification. The learner classifies a change by checking whether the material remains the same or whether one or more new substances are formed. If an object looks different after a change, the change must be chemical.
